018package org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc;
019
020import static java.lang.String.format;
021import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
022
023import javax.lang.model.element.Element;
024import java.util.List;
025
026import org.apiguardian.api.API;
027import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.CustomTagletBase;
028import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
029import com.sun.source.doctree.DocTree;
030
031/**
032 *  <p>{@summary This taglet is used to refer to the author of the model for
033 *  the current piece of code or the person who provided the idea for that
034 *  code.} It requires that reference to that person in the format below:</p>
035 *  <pre><code>  &#x40;thanks &lt;<i>name</i>&gt; <b>-</b> &lt;<i>email address</i>&gt;</code></pre>
036 *  <p>Basically, this is the name of the author, followed by their email
037 *  address, separated by a hyphen (&quot;&#x2d;&quot; &amp;#x2d), surrounded
038 *  by blanks.</p>
039 *  <p>If there is no email address, just the name will be shown in the
040 *  output.</p>
041 *
042 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
043 *  @version $Id: ThanksTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
044 *  @since 0.0.5
045 */
046@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: ThanksTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
047@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.0.5" )
048public final class ThanksTaglet extends CustomTagletBase
049{
050        /*-----------*\
051    ====** Constants **========================================================
052        \*-----------*/
053    /**
054     *  <p>{@summary The name of this taglet: {@value}.}</p>
055     */
056    public static final String TAGLET_NAME = "thanks";
057
058        /*--------------*\
059    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
060        \*--------------*/
061    /**
062     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new {@code ThanksTaglet} instance.}</p>
063     */
064    public ThanksTaglet()
065    {
066        super( TAGLET_NAME, false, Location.values() );
067    }   //  ThanksTaglet()
068
069        /*---------*\
070    ====** Methods **==========================================================
071        \*---------*/
072    /**
073     *  {@inheritDoc}
074     */
075    @Override
076    public final String toString( final List<? extends DocTree> tags, final Element element )
077    {
078        final var template =
079            """
080
081            <dt><span class="simpleTagLabel">Thanks to:</span></dt>
082              <dd>%s</dd>
083            """;
084
085        final var retValue = format( template, parseNameAndEmail( tags ) );
086
087        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
088        return retValue;
089    }   //  toString()
090}
091//  class ThanksTaglet
092
093/*
094 *  End of File
095 */
